messages.en:
I got your written
challenge and I'm ready!

Don't waste your time on
letters! You gotta train!

I love getting stuff in
the mail! Keep it up!

Ha HA! Your letter made
me laugh 'til my abs hurt!

I was working out when I
read your letter. Sweaty!

I'm writing you back, in
case you couldn't tell.

I was pumped to get your
letter! Here's my opinion.

You're pressing hard with
that pen. Getting strong!

Thanks for the good
words! Means a lot to me!

Losing is not an option!
Keep training!

I just ate five protein
bars! Yeah, I'm a machine!

Excuse the sloppy writing,
but I just cranked a set!

I didn't get your fancy-
schmancy letter!

Your letters still crack
me up, {04 0f 00}!

I've got lightning-quick
reflexes! Here's my reply.

I read your letter! You're
quite the poet, huh.

My mailbox is full of
junk! What a pain!

That one line in your
letter hit me right here!

Your letters have as much
character as you do. Nice!

I say it loud in letters,
too! Ready, set, GO!
